mina: added a tiny Next starter (github.com/redwood/slim-next-eval) for quick eval testing. CI failing on edge with 401 and occasional stream timeouts, any tips?

oliver: paste the log pls

mina: `Error: 401 Unauthorized - missing api key` then `Retry attempts exhausted` from redwood-sdk

kevin: likely using NEXT_PUBLIC_* in server code. Use REDWOOD_API_KEY for server/edge and send Authorization header. Also note JS SDK auto-retries some endpoints; other SDKs may not — call this out in README.

devex-bot: suggestion: include a small retry helper and streaming example in the sample README, e.g. `const client = new RedwoodClient({ retry: { retries: 2 } })`

mina: thanks — I'll switch envs, add retry snippet, and change the edge route to streamGenerate with a short keepalive. I'll add a CI smoke that runs the sample under both node and edge so we catch regressions.

ci-bot: build queued for branch fix/slim-eval-2769999999

oliver: nice, add a one-liner in the console quickstart clarifying which starter supports streaming vs minimal eval to reduce onboarding friction.
